Prepare budget vs actual analysis and present findings to the Head of Finance and entity CEO(s). review_candidates.description: Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects. To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best. Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations About Kirby Group Engineering Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance. Role Purpose As the Civil Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for a number of projects within the business unit, providing leadership and expertise while monitoring the progressive performance of Inspection and Test activities associated with civil construction works. The position will support project(s) from pre-construction phase through to successful project handover, ensuring all quality control deliverables are completed in accordance with project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards. Civil QC Engineer Responsibilities Lead by example in the areas of ethics, EHS, cultural sensitivity, diversity, teamwork, quality culture, and behaviours. Comply with all Project EHS requirements including PPE, work permits, procedures, etc. Where required, support the development of project-specific method statements and inspection test plans. Understand Kirby values and Quality Policy and create a culture of “being proud of the projects we deliver” and “Right First Time” amongst the team. Establish close working relationships with cross-functional departments (Planning, Engineering, Operations, Commissioning, EHS, etc.), including supply chain and client stakeholders. Liaise with the Kirby Autodesk ACC team for field space creation and project custom attributes. Develop, maintain, and monitor Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and checklist approvals for civil works in line with project specifications and submittal due dates. Develop and agree Quality Record and Handover Dossier requirements with relevant project stakeholders. Define and develop inspection boundaries, hold points, witness points, and testing requirements for civil works packages, including tracking of quality documentation. Implement quality tracking and verification processes for construction materials including concrete, reinforcement, structural steel, aggregates, drainage products, and other permanent works materials. Encourage progressive compilation of lessons learned during project execution. Conduct project lessons learned workshops with supply chain and project teams to prevent recurrence of issues. Compile hard copy and/or digital quality dossiers for project handover. Track issues, defects, and snags while driving closeout with project teams and ensuring data integrity is maintained. Review benchmark and first-of-kind activities and report progress. Review and monitor calibration certificates for surveying, testing, and measurement equipment. Monitor Power BI analytics for accurate project reporting on quality issues, inspections, checklists, and planned versus actual metrics. Ensure data integrity across BIM 360 and ACC project platforms, ensuring quality observations and issues are categorised correctly with appropriate ownership and due dates. Monitor KPI performance and supply chain quality performance, developing action plans where required. Promote a positive quality culture onsite. Identify and recognise operatives and subcontractors demonstrating quality excellence onsite. Complete root cause analysis, manage NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports), and monitor corrective and preventative actions where required. Verify quality compliance of civil works including earthworks, foundations, reinforced concrete structures, cable trenches, ducting systems, drainage networks, roads, hardstands, and substation infrastructure. Necessary Requirements Of The Civil QC Engineer Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent construction-related qualification. 5+ years’ Quality Management experience in an Engineering & Construction environment. Experience on HV/MV Substation, Power, Renewables, Transmission & Distribution, or Infrastructure projects. Experience inspecting and quality managing civil works including earthworks, foundations, reinforced concrete, drainage, roads, and underground services. Knowledge of relevant industry standards, specifications, and testing requirements applicable to civil construction works. Understanding of quality requirements relating to substation and energy infrastructure projects. Ability to lead root cause analysis techniques and implement corrective actions. ISO 9001 Auditor certification and experience. Knowledge to scope, plan, and execute quality and risk reviews. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to provide technical and professional guidance for project teams. Excellent attention to detail and organisational/planning skills. Able to create and implement quality control processes and procedures. For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies – Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411. Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

review_candidates.title: Business Operations Specialist - FinOps Engineering
review_candidates.description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage's Applications: Our Applications business unit focuses on delivering a suite of advanced communication tools designed to enhance customer engagement. From cloud contact centers to feature-rich unified communications solutions, our Applications team is dedicated to providing businesses with the tools they need to streamline operations and improve customer experiences. Why This Role Matters: We are seeking a Business Operations Specialist focusing on Financial Operations to support and optimize our global Engineering team. This person will report directly to the Senior Engineering operations Manager and will be responsible for driving key initiatives that enhance the performance, efficiency, and scalability of the engineering organization. The role will involve managing the capture and execution of OKRs, preparing high-level reports for the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), overseeing and optimizing key operational processes across various domains such as FinOps, Architecture, and Application Performance Your key responsibilities : Process Optimization: Work across teams to establish and improve best practices and processes in areas like Quality Assurance (QA), Financial Operations (FinOps), and Architecture. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance team productivity. Assist in the design and implementation of scalable and repeatable operational processes across the organization. OKR Management: Capture, track, and drive the execution of OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) for the engineering team. Collaborate with leadership to ensure alignment between engineering goals and organizational priorities. Regularly assess progress and ensure teams stay focused on critical objectives. Reporting and Metrics: Have obsessive attention to detail and the ability to quickly notice at a glance that the numbers “don’t make sense”. Prepare and present high-level performance reports to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) that highlight key metrics, trends, and insights across the engineering department. Drive data-driven decision-making by developing actionable insights and improving visibility into team performance. Project Oversight: Provide oversight for high-visibility or strategically important projects to ensure they meet milestones, budgets, and quality standards. Coordinate with project leads to monitor timelines, identify roadblocks, and drive resolution of critical issues. Requirements : 5+ years of experience in operations and a FinOps Foundation Professional Certification , preferably within a technology or engineering environment managing Cloud and Vendor costs. Proven track record of managing OKRs and driving cross-functional initiatives. Strong experience with reporting, metrics analysis, and presenting to executive leadership.. Experience in process optimization, with a demonstrable understanding of SDLC, CI/CD, QA, FinOps, and General Software Architecture. Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence at all levels of the organization. Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) and reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Strong understanding of software engineering principles and the ability to translate technical processes into business impact. A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in project management (e.g., Finops Foundation, PMP) are a plus. How you’ll benefit: Discretionary Time Off Private Medical Healthcare Pension scheme Ericsson support line Hybrid work Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.
